# Papers

> > Papers is an award-winning reference management platform that helps students, academics, and organizations find, organize, read, and cite scholarly research with AI-powered assistance.

Papers offers comprehensive literature management solutions across desktop, mobile, and web platforms, featuring AI-powered research analysis, SmartCite citation tools supporting 9000+ styles, and collaboration capabilities for teams and institutions. The platform serves individual researchers, academic departments, and enterprise organizations with flexible pricing and integration options.

## Key Topics

- Reference Management
- Literature Management

- SmartCite Citation Tools
- PDF Management
- Citation Styles (9000+)
- Collaboration
- ReadCube
- Papers Pro

- Research Tools
- Academic Writing
